name: Text Path Scroll
description: Long dark scroll page where quotes run along curved SVG paths and slide with scroll, with blur, glow and distortion filters reacting to scroll speed, between image grids and big photos.
contents: Fixed-looking header overlay with heading, counter, nav links and eyebrow line
Curved text lines on SVG paths
Two large images and a footer link row
behavior: Text slides along its curve as the page scrolls, with eased interpolation
Blur, glow or displacement filter strength follows scroll velocity
Animation runs only while a curve is in view
Header overlay is hidden below the md breakpoint
editableByProps: All text, curves, paths, filter types and font sizes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change where curves and grids are placed in the page order
needsCodeEdit.where: renderCurve calls in the TextBasedScroll return block

needsCodeEdit.change: Make nav links point to real URLs

fixed: Curves are placed by index: 0-1, 2-3, 4-6 and 7 at fixed spots between grids and images
Grid items are split 2, 2, 2, 2 across the page
Large vertical spacing and margins give the scroll effect room
Relies on window scroll position, so it should be used in the main page scroll
Header overlay is hidden on screens below 768px
